newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy metalworkers union hopes for deal by Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Italy metalworkers union hopes for deal by Sunday.

text.p: The leader of one of the three trades unions in Italy's engineering and metalworking industry said on Thursday that he hoped a deal with employers in their protracted pay dispute could be reached by Sunday.

Luigi Angeletti, leader of the UILM union, spoke to reporters on his way into a further round of talks with the employers group Federmeccanica at the Labour Ministry. The other two sector unions are FIM and FIOM.
"My hope is to close a deal by Sunday," he said.
Sergio D'Antoni, leader of the CISL union confederation, earlier told reporters the talks were "in a delicate phase which could result in a contract being signed".

Talks between unions and employers resumed on Monday for the first time in more than a month to try to end the pay dispute which involves some 1.7 million workers. The sector's two-year contract expired in June.
